comment: Sanctioned upward-closure violations. Each entry suppresses exactly the listed missing items at the named site; when the repair lands the entry goes stale and fails the gate until removed. 'pending' names the worktree branch that owns the fix; 'evidence' documents why the set is deliberately not upward-closed.

exceptions.reason: The 5.3.02 editor-model record drops the same eight morph-target/part selectors the 5.3.01 record carried.
exceptions.evidence: Deliberate exact-use truncation: records admit only the selectors the runtime slice actually consumes, and the >=5.3.02 editor-model generation does not consume these eight aliases. Backfilling them would assert unverified internal member names, so the regression is recorded as an explicit exception rather than papered over.

exceptions.reason: The three CUBISM_VERSION_* constants look like an admission set but are only slice-id dispatch keys.
exceptions.evidence: authorizes(resolver) admits every ReviewedHostArtifacts.reviewedCubismVersions() entry; the constants merely pick adapter-slice ids, so no reviewed version is refused.

exceptions.reason: artifactProfile's case arms look like a version set.
exceptions.evidence: The switch is an identity mapping: 'default -> reviewedVersion' passes every admitted version through unchanged; the two case arms exist only as the single place a profile-id divergence would live.

exceptions.reason: SUPPORTED_VERSION pins a single version.
exceptions.evidence: Property-gated validation diagnostic (turboism.validation.editorTextureReplaceDiagnostic) that was authored and reviewed against the exact 5.3.02 host; it is a diagnostic tool, not a capability admission set.

exceptions.reason: A single-version CUBISM_5_3_03.equals(artifact) guard looks like admission.
exceptions.evidence: The guard only selects the optional 5.3.03 validation-candidate runtime scope (admits5303ValidationCandidate); every reviewed artifact still gets a resolver with a null extra scope.

exceptions.reason: fpsTargetsForVersion names 5.3.02/5.3.03 before its fallback.
exceptions.evidence: The final branch admits every ReviewedHostArtifacts.reviewedCubismVersions() entry and returns the generic cubism5203() targets; the two named arms are fast paths, not an admission set.

exceptions.reason: The manifest names one exact version.
exceptions.evidence: Task-scoped runtime admission for the exact-host 5.3.03 validation lane (admits5303ValidationCandidate); the lane runs one version by design.

exceptions.reason: The contract names one exact record version constant.
exceptions.evidence: CUBISM_5_3_03_VERSION is a dispatch constant referencing the 5.3.03 record whose onion-skin shape the contract special-cases; version admission flows through the record itself, not this constant.

exceptions.reason: The popup mesh undo contract binds obfuscated actionManager members recovered from the exact 5.3.02 artifact and is gated by that artifact's digest.
exceptions.pending: model-import-3d-version-adaptation: recover the corresponding obfuscated member names on the exact 5.3.03 and 5.3.04 artifacts, then extend ADMITTED or record bytecode evidence that the host lacks the popup mesh undo surface.

exceptions.reason: REVIEWED_CLASSES pins exact GShader class digests per host artifact; the 5.3.04 GShader bytes were not reviewed when model-import-3d landed.
exceptions.pending: model-import-3d-version-adaptation: digest the 5.3.04 GShader class and admit it under the matching REVIEWED_CLASSES entry (or record a new digest row if Live2D changed the bytes).

exceptions.reason: The shared CLASS_SHA256 digest row admits only the artifacts the shader uniform review actually hashed.
exceptions.pending: model-import-3d-version-adaptation: same as the sibling row — admit 5.3.04 once its GShader bytes are hashed and confirmed identical or pinned separately.

exceptions.reason: The 5.3.02-only branches (directBinding fallback and reinit-input route) encode a host quirk verified on the exact 5.3.02 artifact; whether 5.3.03+ shares the quirk was not reviewed.
exceptions.pending: model-import-3d-version-adaptation: on exact 5.3.03 and 5.3.04 artifacts confirm whether atlas authoring before the editor window opens needs the same directBinding/reinit-input route; widen the dispatch or record per-version evidence.

exceptions.reason: The merged 5.3.03 editor-model record carries capabilityIds/aliases contributed by the model-import-3d work, verified on the exact 5.2.03/5.3.02/5.3.03 artifacts; the independently reviewed 5.3.04 record does not yet carry them.
exceptions.pending: model-import-3d-version-adaptation: propagate the new selectors and capabilities to the 5.3.04 record after exact-artifact review, or record bytecode evidence that the members are absent on 5.3.04.

exceptions.reason: The merged 5.3.03 editor-model record carries capabilityIds/aliases contributed by the model-import-3d work, verified on the exact 5.2.03/5.3.02/5.3.03 artifacts; the independently reviewed 5.3.04 record does not yet carry them.
exceptions.pending: model-import-3d-version-adaptation: propagate the new selectors and capabilities to the 5.3.04 record after exact-artifact review, or record bytecode evidence that the members are absent on 5.3.04.
